# Language Flipper

> Language Flipper is a macOS and Windows desktop app that instantly fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout. When a bilingual user accidentally types in Hebrew while their layout is set to English (or vice versa), the result is gibberish. Language Flipper corrects it in place with a single hotkey — Cmd+Shift+Y on Mac, Ctrl+Shift+Y on Windows — without retyping. It is the most actively maintained alternative to Langover for Hebrew-English keyboard correction.

Language Flipper is developed by a small team based in Tel Aviv, Israel. It is distributed as a freemium desktop app: 40 free flips for life, then $9.99/year via Gumroad. The app works entirely offline; no text is sent to any server.

## Core capability

Language Flipper detects whether the selected (or current-line) text is Hebrew typed in an English layout or English typed in a Hebrew layout, swaps every character through a fixed mapping table, replaces the text on screen, and then switches the OS keyboard layout to match — all in under a second. It works in any app on macOS (via the Accessibility API) and Windows (via the clipboard).

## Pricing

- Free: 40 lifetime flips, no time limit, no account required
- Premium: $9.99/year, unlimited flips, Gumroad license key, 14-day refund guarantee

## Platform support

- macOS: .app bundle, installed via DMG. Hotkey: Cmd+Shift+Y
- Windows: single-file .exe installer. Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+Y

## Compared to Langover

Langover is a long-established Hebrew keyboard fixer for Windows only. Language Flipper differs in three ways: it supports both macOS and Windows, it is actively maintained with regular releases, and it runs as a lightweight system-tray process. Mac users have no native Langover option, so Language Flipper is the primary Langover alternative on macOS.
